replies.author: KingofKingsofKingsof
replies.body: Only listen to players, don't listen to random redditors who often give lowest common denominator comments. If the game needs more identifiable enemies then do it, but if that's antithetical to the game then don't do it. If you have a vision, stick to it unless your vision has been proved wrong.
